# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, the `main` branch and latest release are supported for security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues to `saadat@nextbridge.com`. We will respond to your report as soon as possible, usually within 24-48 hours.

When reporting a vulnerability, please provide:
* The version of RepoCode you are using
* Steps to reproduce the vulnerability
* Any other relevant context or materials

Thank you for helping keep RepoCode safe!
